versioning.status: Reconstructed historical product versions; no release tags were present and package.json remained 0.1.0. These dates describe development, not verified production deployment dates.
versioning.convention: One entry per development date. Major: new principal business workflow. Minor: capability within that generation. Patch: fixes, compatibility, documentation or maintenance. Reset lower components after increment.

initial_milestone.reason: Both initial repositories already contain contract/account workflows and PDF/DOCX generation.

major_milestones.reason: Dedicated subcontracting workflow, company settings and project integration.

versioning.current_implementation: The 2026-10-09 entry additionally includes the changelog, release announcements and dark mode implemented after the audited repository heads. Its draft is published only after the matching frontend is healthy.
